Generated seccomp filter allowing write and fsync only for fd 2 or logfile_fd.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for `fd_plugin_tile`. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture and then allows only the `write` and `fsync` system calls under fixed argument rules. The `write` call is allowed only when file descriptor `2` or `logfile_fd` is used, and `fsync` is allowed only for `logfile_fd`. All other system calls or mismatched conditions end with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`, and [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_plugin_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_plugin_tile>) copies the prepared filter into the caller buffer.
